title: C version_is_newer disagrees with RFC 6550 7.2
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/dodag.c treats mixed linear/circular as linear-always-newer and circular diffs as (a-b)&0x7F in (0,16]. RFC 6550 7.2 / rust lollipop_cmp / Python rw5e: same-region |diff|>16 is incomparable; cross-region wrap distance <=16 makes wrapped newer (240 vs 5 -> 240 newer; 250 vs 5 -> 5 newer). Align C and add the shared RFC table.
close_reason: Aligned C static version_is_newer/lollipop_cmp in lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/dodag.c with RFC 6550 Section 7.2 SEQUENCE_WINDOW=16 (same-region incomparable, cross-region wrap distance, 0 vs 127 special case). Exported LICHEN_RPL_TEST hooks lichen_rpl_lollipop_cmp + lichen_rpl_version_is_newer; declared in rpl_dodag.h under #ifdef LICHEN_RPL_TEST. Host test lichen/tests/rpl_dodag copies rust/RFC table as independent expected values. Verify: cmake -S lichen/tests/rpl_dodag -B lichen/tests/rpl_dodag/build && cmake --build lichen/tests/rpl_dodag/build && ./lichen/tests/rpl_dodag/build/rpl_dodag_test → 5/5 passed (ctest 1/1). clang-tidy TEST TU clean. Header changed: yes (test-hook decls only).
